title: Chemistry.
description: Master atomic structure, bonding, quantitative chemistry and organic chemistry with a strong focus on exam technique and required practicals.

sections.title: Atomic Structure and the Periodic Table
sections.text: Subatomic particles, electronic structure, isotopes, development of the periodic table and trends.

sections.title: Bonding and Structure
sections.text: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, properties of substances, giant structures and intermolecular forces.

sections.title: Quantitative Chemistry
sections.text: Relative formula mass, moles, balancing equations, reacting masses and gas volumes.

sections.title: Chemical Changes
sections.text: Reactivity series, acids and bases, electrolysis, extraction of metals.

sections.title: Energy Changes
sections.text: Exothermic and endothermic reactions, reaction profiles and bond energy calculations.

sections.title: Rates and Equilibrium
sections.text: Collision theory, factors affecting rate, reversible reactions and dynamic equilibrium (HT).

sections.title: Organic Chemistry
sections.text: Crude oil fractions, alkanes, alkenes, alcohols, carboxylic acids and polymers.

sections.title: Chemical Analysis and Atmosphere
sections.text: Chromatography, gas tests, Earth's atmosphere and climate change.
